name: Backup Bolt – Lightweight Backup, Fast WordPress Backup to ZIP
author: Backup Bolt

sections.description:
Backup Bolt is a lightweight WordPress backup plugin that lets you create and download site backups with a single click. Choose between a custom backup to save storage space or a complete backup of your WordPress site. With its clean, straightforward interface and ZIP compression, Backup Bolt makes website backups quick, simple, and easy to manage.

BACKUP FEATURES

= Simple, One-Click Backup Interface =
Backup Bolt provides a clean and straightforward interface designed to make WordPress backups easy for everyone. Start a backup with a single click without navigating through complicated settings or technical options.

Custom Backups to Save Storage

Create a custom backup when you only need selected site files or data. This helps reduce backup size, save storage space, and make downloads faster when a complete site backup is not required.

Complete WordPress Site Backups

When you need full protection, create a complete backup of your WordPress site. Back up your site content and essential WordPress files together in one convenient archive.

Backup Size and Available Memory Information

Before and during the backup process, Backup Bolt helps you understand the expected backup size in relation to available memory. This gives you useful information when preparing larger backups.

Faster ZIP Backup Processing

Backup Bolt uses the PCLZIP library to process and package backup files into ZIP archives. This provides a practical way to create compressed backups while keeping the workflow lightweight.

Real-Time Backup Progress Logging

Follow the backup process through real-time activity logs. The progress information makes it easier to see what Backup Bolt is doing and helps you monitor the status of an active backup.

Efficient Large Backup Creation

Backup Bolt is designed to generate large backups efficiently, helping you protect bigger WordPress websites without an unnecessarily complicated process.

Download Backups as ZIP Files

Once the backup is complete, download it as a compressed ZIP file. ZIP archives are convenient to store, transfer, and keep available for future site recovery needs.

Automatic Daily Backup Cleanup

To help manage storage consumption, older backup files are automatically deleted daily. This keeps backup storage under control and helps prevent unnecessary files from accumulating on your server.

Show Your Support

  • Rate Plugin – If you find this plugin useful, please leave a positive review. Your reviews are our biggest motivation for further development of the plugin.
  • Submit a Bug – If you find any issue, please submit a bug via support forum.

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin
  2. Upload the plugin to the wp-content/plugins directory,
  3. Go to “plugins” in your WordPress admin, then click activate.
  4. You will now see Backup Bolt option on your left navigation bar. Click on it and start taking backups.
sections.faq:
How fast is the backup process?

Backup Bolt initiates backup via PHP PclZip which is the most powerful and fastest solution possible compared to any other backup methods. Usually backups are completed within seconds!.

Does backups consume large memory?

You can choose “Custom” backup option to backup only the important wp-content part of your WordPress site so the rest can be downloaded directly via wp.org when you are restoring the backup. At the end, the backups are zip compressed for lowest memory consumption.

How long are the backups retained on server?

Backup Bolt is focused towards storage optimization so backups are auto deleted after 24 hours to avoid flooding server storage. We recommend downloading the backup to your local computer immediately after running the backup.

Where are the backup files stored?

Backups are stored in a secure dynamic folder located in wp-content/backup-bolt-*

Does repeated backups increase backup size?

Backups created by Backup Bolt are always excluded in further backup process so the backup size remains same even if you backup multiple times.
